outcome_detail.diagnosis_hint: Cost reached $5.20 in 3 iterations (avg $1.73/iter). Goal was too large for single-goal closed loop — 'rewrite entire auth system' touches 4 files with 580 diff lines. Each iteration consumed massive context (30 messages by iter 3). ISSUE: max_total_cost_usd default ($5) is appropriate — goal was correctly stopped. But skill should detect oversized goals and suggest splitting into sub-goals. Also: progress WAS happening (3 failing tests → 2 failing tests), so this is a legitimate cost limit, not a quality problem.
